block.comment: Normal follow fallback: F=10 holds; left/right proportional steering. Lap finish, wide marker, short gap and sharp-turn states have priority. The preserved legacy F=0 loop counter is bypassed by the gap/turn states.
Original 115200-baud raw ADC/F telemetry; no new capture protocol.
Position weights: A4=-1, A3=0, A2=+1. Integer proportional inner PWM; minimum5.
Exclude A1 and A5 from decisions; control uses A4/A3/A2 only.
Read all five ADCs; preserve original raw telemetry.

Start on the narrow line LEFT of the large finish patch, facing away from finish. Three-center-sensor control, sharp corners and short gaps. After departure/minimum run, sustained wide line latches finish stop. This is not measured lap localization. Button waits at boot only.
Bounded left/right pivot for sharp 60/90-degree corners. End on centered line, not a measured angle. Timeout latches stop until reset; no automatic restart.
Straight short-gap crossing, PWM70, fixed 250ms total limit. No pivot during a gap. Reacquire narrow line for three samples; wide line returns to marker handling.

Lift: first confirmed wide marker after narrow-line departure, based on user route assumption. Stop without alignment drive; provisional wait28350ms from stop command, not measured settled feedback. Auto exit PWM45 with 1500ms limit. Consume marker once. PWM zero is not active braking. Disable LIFT_ENABLED for the earlier practice mat without a lift.
